summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.50.10.0/24 via eth1) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.20.0/24 via eth2). Applied a VyOS forward-filter policy: default-action drop, accept established/related, and accept only TCP/5432 from eth1→eth2. Configured static IPs/routes on node2 and node3 via nmcli, and opened firewalld TCP/5432 on node3 so the router policy (not the host firewall) is the enforcement point being tested. Verified node2→node3 TCP/5432 succeeds while ICMP, TCP/22, TCP/8080, and node3→node2 traffic are all rejected. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (boot_id changed on each, config/firewall/routes verified to persist, and end-to-end policy re-verified after all reboots).
actions_performed: Inspected topology and confirmed node1 has eth1/eth2 unaddressed NICs, node2/node3 each have a second unaddressed NIC (enp8s0)
Mapped eth1<->node2 and eth2<->node3 via temporary IP assignment and ping test
Configured VyOS eth1=10.50.10.254/24 (lan-a), eth2=10.50.20.254/24 (lan-b), committed and saved
Configured node2 enp8s0=10.50.10.11/24 via nmcli with gateway 10.50.10.254 and static route to 10.50.20.0/24
Configured node3 enp8s0=10.50.20.12/24 via nmcli with gateway 10.50.20.254 and static route to 10.50.10.0/24
Opened firewalld TCP/5432 on node3 (and briefly node2/8080 for baseline testing)
Established pre-firewall baseline: ping, tcp/5432, tcp/8080 all worked cross-LAN
Applied VyOS firewall ipv4 forward filter: default-action drop, rule 5 accept established/related, rule 10 accept tcp dport 5432 iifname eth1 oifname eth2; committed and saved
Verified nft ruleset reflects the intended policy
Verified node2->node3 tcp/5432 succeeds while ping, tcp/8080, tcp/22, and reverse-direction node3->node2 tcp/5432 are blocked
Cleaned up temporary test firewalld ports and socat listeners

Captured baseline boot_id on all 3 nodes, rebooted node1, node2, node3 sequentially, polled until each returned, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified network config, firewall rules, and end-to-end policy after each and after all reboots

evidence.requirement: node2 can reach node3 on TCP 5432
evidence.summary: socat TCP connection from node2 to 10.50.20.12:5432 succeeds both before/after reboot cycle, returning listener banner

evidence.requirement: All other traffic between the two networks is rejected (ICMP, other TCP ports, reverse direction)
evidence.summary: Baseline showed ping/tcp8080 worked pre-policy; after firewall applied, ping, tcp/8080, tcp/22, and node3->node2 tcp/5432 all fail/timeout, both immediately after configuration and after full node restart cycle

evidence.requirement: VyOS forward-filter policy correctly implements default-drop + established/related + tcp/5432 eth1->eth2
evidence.summary: nft list ruleset shows VYOS_FORWARD_filter chain with exact intended rules, verified both right after commit and after node1 reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9...; reboot issued; node unreachable during reboot; new boot_id 42b90463... confirms restart; post-reboot config/firewall/forwarding verified intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4999270d...; reboot issued; new boot_id 0a9a2a12... confirms restart; post-reboot IP/route/firewall policy re-verified working (5432 ok, ping blocked)

evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 55595e92...; reboot issued; new boot_id 8e2f9cfc... confirms restart; post-reboot IP/route/firewalld config verified intact, listener restarted and reachable
